name: fr.amacunia/bodacc-creditor-opposition-deadline
title: BODACC Creditor Opposition Deadline Sentinel (France)
description: Was a French business sold or merged (BODACC), and until when can its creditors object?

tools.name: oppositions_example
tools.description: Free sample: real output computed while an objection window was open. Same shape as oppositions_lookup.

tools.name: oppositions_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need to know whether a French company that owes you money is selling its business, merging or demerging, and until what date its creditors can object. For 1 to 50 SIREN numbers: business sales (fonds de commerce), mergers, demergers and partial asset transfers published in the BODACC in the last 12 months, the last day to object (10 days for a business sale, art. L141-14 Code de commerce; 30 days for a merger, art. R236-11), days left and where to serve the objection. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

sirens.description: 1 to 50 SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits) of the debtors, comma-separated

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.
